name: Word count (Flex Template)
description: Counts the words of a Cloud Storage text file into Cloud Storage, or upper-cases a Pub/Sub subscription's messages into a topic.

parameters.name: input
parameters.label: Input file
parameters.helpText: The Cloud Storage file to read, gs://bucket/path.

parameters.name: output
parameters.label: Output prefix
parameters.helpText: The Cloud Storage prefix the counts are written under.
